_meta.stage: career (Origin Path final step) + Stage 3 XP spend
_meta.source: Rogue Trader Core Rulebook, Chapter II: Career Paths (pp.36-73)
_meta.status: Rank 1 reconciled-by-hand; Ranks 2-8 built by tools/build_career_ranks.py from the Core/ItS PDF per-rank tables, errata v1.4 applied explicitly, costs cross-checked vs rules/raw/career_advances.json.
_meta.scope: Core (8 careers) + Into the Storm (Kroot Mercenary, Ork Freebooter). All 10 careers carry full Rank 1-8 progressions.
notes: starting_xp 500 verified Core p.31 ('an additional 500 xp that they may spend').
char_advance_scheme: four cumulative tiers Simple/Intermediate/Trained/Expert (Core p.38). Each tier = +5 to the characteristic.
ranks: list of {rank, title, xp_to_advance, advances:[Advance]} for ranks 1-8. rank1_advances is exposed by the engine as ranks[0].advances (backward-compatible alias).

xp_to_advance: cumulative TOTAL spent-xp threshold to reach that rank, uniform across all RT careers (Core p.36 rank table). Rank 1=5000 (the notional Rank-1 baseline), 2=7000, 3=10000, 4=13000, 5=17000, 6=21000, 7=25000, 8=30000.
title: the in-scope RT/ItS careers have NO flavour rank titles in the books or the Daryl Tose 'Career Ranks' sheet, so title is the generic 'Rank N'.

Ranks 2-8 sourced from the rulebook per-rank advance tables (clean names + prerequisites); the book PDF is PRE-errata, so the documented errata v1.4 add/delete/cost changes are applied explicitly in build_career_ranks.py (see docs/errata-notes.md).
prereqs are characteristic minima (e.g. 'Fel 30'), required skills, and/or required talents; 'Special' prereqs are flagged for rules-qa.
max_ranks on a talent advance = how many times it may be bought (the '(x2)'/'(x3)' notation, e.g. Sound Constitution).

special_abilities.name: Exceptional Leader
special_abilities.text: As a free action once per round, grant an ally he can see and who can hear him +10% to any one test.

special_abilities.name: Weapon Master
special_abilities.text: Choose one class of weapon; gain +10% to hit, +2 damage, and +2 initiative when using a weapon of that class.

special_abilities.name: Soul-Bound to the Emperor
special_abilities.text: +20 WP resisting possession / opposed WP vs daemons / WP tests vs daemon effects; rolls an extra d10 on Perils of the Warp and may discard one die.

special_abilities.name: Psychic Powers
special_abilities.text: Begins with access to the Telepathic Discipline and the technique Astral Telepathy, plus two additional Telepathic techniques; begins with Psy Rating 2.

special_abilities.name: See Without Eyes
special_abilities.text: Blind but perceives without physical sight; unaffected by vision-targeting effects, cannot see Untouchables.

starting_traits.name: Mechanicus Implants
starting_traits.text: The Explorator begins play with the Mechanicus Implants Trait (Core p.366).

special_abilities.name: Explorator Implants
special_abilities.text: Begins with Mechanicus Implants; may select up to two additional common-Craftsmanship bionic implants and improve their Craftsmanship for 200 xp each (max twice, at creation only).

special_abilities.name: Pure Faith
special_abilities.text: The Missionary begins play with the Pure Faith Talent (Core p.104).

special_abilities.name: Warp Eye
special_abilities.text: Begins with the Lidless Stare Navigator power; may select one additional power or improve an existing one.

special_abilities.name: The Boons of Lineage
special_abilities.text: Hails from a Navigator lineage (Nomadic / Magisterial / Shrouded / Renegade) granting advantages and quirks (Core pp.176-178).

special_abilities.name: Navigator Mutations
special_abilities.text: Begins play with a number of Navigator Mutations determined by his Lineage.

special_abilities.name: Seeker of Lore
special_abilities.text: May spend a Fate Point to auto-succeed at any Ciphers, Lore, or Logic Test (min time); adds +1 DoS to successful Commerce, Inquiry, or Evaluate Tests.

special_abilities.name: Void-master Mastery
special_abilities.text: Select one: Mastery of Space / Gunnery / Augurs / Small Craft (re-roll failed tests of that kind aboard ship).

careers.name: Kroot Mercenary
careers._provenance: Into the Storm, Chapter II: Koronus Careers. Career intro / starting bundle: printed folio 52 (PDF page-53). Characteristic advance scheme + Rank 1 advance table: printed folio 53 (PDF page-54). Cross-checked vs rules/raw/careers.json + rules/raw/career_advances.json (errata-current). Errata v1.4 (folio 52): Kroot Mercenaries begin play with Melee Weapon Training (Primitive) added to starting talents; Shadowing buyable at Rank 3 (200xp) / Shadowing +10 at Rank 6 (200xp) -- those are ranks 3/6, not Rank 1.

starting_traits.name: Unnatural Strength (x2)
starting_traits.text: Kroot Mercenary starting trait: double the Strength Bonus for relevant purposes. ItS folio 52.

special_abilities.name: Kroot Kindred
special_abilities.text: A Kroot character must select one Kindred (combination of clan and tribe), gaining its benefits. ItS folio 49-50.

effects.name: Kindred: Bold Hunter
effects.text: +5 BS, +5 to Wrangling Tests, +10 to resist Fear or Pinning. ItS folio 49.

effects.name: Kindred: Cunning Hybrid
effects.text: +10 Int, +5 to Barter and Deceive Tests, +1 Initiative. ItS folio 49.

effects.name: Kindred: Greenskin Hybrid
effects.text: +10 Toughness (applied AFTER calculating starting Wounds). ItS folio 49.

effects.name: Kindred: Headhunter
effects.text: Automatically passes all Toughness Tests to resist toxins and Toxic-Quality weapons; the Kroot's beak loses Primitive and gains Toxic. ItS folio 49.

effects.name: Kindred: Stalker
effects.text: May make Concealment and Silent Move Tests as a Free Action, even while being observed. ItS folio 50.

careers.name: Ork Freebooter
careers._provenance: Into the Storm, Chapter II: Koronus Careers. Career intro / starting bundle: printed folio 66 (PDF page-67). Characteristic advance scheme + Rank 1 advance table: printed folio 67 (PDF page-68). Ork origin-role sub-choices Da Klan (folio 61, PDF page-62) and Orky Know-Wotz (folio 62, PDF page-63). Cross-checked vs rules/raw/careers.json + rules/raw/career_advances.json (errata-current). ERRATA v1.4 (folio 52): Mekboy and Painboy Orky Know-Wotz origins grant +5 Intelligence in addition to their other benefits -- applied here via the orky_know_wotz choice so it lands exactly once and only via the career. Ork base characteristics WS35/BS15/S35 + species traits live in species.json, not here.

special_abilities.name: Peer (Own Klan)
special_abilities.text: Ork Freebooter starting talent: Peer with the Ork's own Klan, chosen below. ItS folio 66.

special_abilities.name: Da Klan
special_abilities.text: Select one Ork Klan, gaining its benefits. ItS folio 61-62.

effects.name: Klan: Bad Moons
effects.text: +20 to Barter when dealing with Orks; +10 to Acquisition Tests dealing with Ork traders / Ork equipment. ItS folio 61.

effects.name: Klan: Blood Axes
effects.text: Gain Common Lore (Imperium) or Concealment as a Trained Skill, and +3 Perception or Agility (chosen). ItS folio 61.

effects.name: Klan: Death Skulls
effects.text: Gain Tech-Use or Sleight of Hand as Trained, and the Runtz Talent; warpaint/charms count as a Charm. ItS folio 62.

effects.name: Klan: Evil Suns
effects.text: Gain Drive (Ground Vehicle) or Tech-Use as a Trained Skill. ItS folio 62.

effects.name: Klan: Snakebites
effects.text: Gain the Resistance (Poison) Talent, and Survival, Tracking, or Wrangling as a Trained Skill. ItS folio 62.

special_abilities.name: Orky Know-Wotz
special_abilities.text: Select one Orky Know-Wotz origin, gaining its benefit. Mekboy and Painboy (Oddboyz) ALSO grant +5 Intelligence per Errata v1.4 (folio 52). ItS folio 62.

effects.name: Know-Wotz: Driva
effects.text: Gain Drive (Ground Vehicle) or Pilot (Flyer or Space Craft) as a Trained Basic Skill. ItS folio 62.

effects.name: Know-Wotz: Hunta
effects.text: Gain Tracking as a Trained Skill. ItS folio 62.

effects.name: Know-Wotz: Mekboy (Oddboy)
effects.text: Gain Tech-Use as a Trained Skill, and +5 Intelligence (Errata v1.4, folio 52). ItS folio 62.

effects.name: Know-Wotz: Painboy (Oddboy)
effects.text: Gain Medicae as a Trained Basic Skill, and +5 Intelligence (Errata v1.4, folio 52). ItS folio 62.

effects.name: Know-Wotz: Runtherd (Oddboy)
effects.text: Gain Wrangling as a Trained Basic Skill. ItS folio 62.

effects.name: Know-Wotz: Trappa
effects.text: Gain Survival as a Trained Basic Skill. ItS folio 62.
